title: Jovial Creamy Turkish Lamb Stew
description: This creamy Turkish lamb stew is a comforting and resinous dish featuring sherry, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a cold winter's night. The slow simmering process brings out the rich flavors of the lamb and spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the sherry and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the coconut cream and let it simmer for an additional 10 minutes, or until the stew has thickened slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
